topics.name: Runtime Health Probe
topics.purpose: Define explicit health probes/checks with exact targets, intervals/timeouts and result semantics.

semantics.identity_rule: Each probe definition has an explicit identity.
semantics.timeout_rule: Probe timeout and evaluation interval are explicit.
semantics.side_effect_rule: Health probe is read-only/non-destructive unless explicitly declared otherwise.
semantics.authority_rule: Probe success does not grant runtime authority.
semantics.evidence_rule: Probe result is derived health evidence.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.

references.purpose: Probe evidence informs runtime health state.
